title: Cantilever beam frequency response
line: A harmonic FEA study of a steel cantilever beam driven from 20 to 200 Hz.
description: Frequency response of a steel cantilever beam (1000 x 100 x 100 mm) fixed at one end. A 100 N force drives the free end vertically, swept from 20 to 200 Hz across the first bending mode. The sweep is solved on the first eight modes, with Rayleigh damping.
thumbnailAlt: Steady vibration amplitude of a steel cantilever beam driven near its first bending mode, solved in RunMat
